meta.name: sprint-status
meta.description: Track parallel work sessions and prevent confusion across multiple Claude Code instances. Every major step ends with a status line. Every question re-states project, branch, and task.

copy.tagline: 跟踪并行工作会话，避免多实例混淆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果同时运行多个 Claude Code 实例需要保持上下文清晰
copy.tagline_en: Track parallel work sessions and prevent confusion across instances
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run multiple Claude Code instances and need clear context

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会在每次决策、计划或重要操作前显示会话标识（项目、分支、任务），并在每个主要步骤结束时输出状态行（COMPLETE、COMPLETE_WITH_NOTES、BLOCKED、NEEDS_INFO）。当用户询问多个会话的状态时，会汇总成冲刺视图。
howto.when: 当检测到多个 Claude Code 会话并行运行时，每次响应都会包含会话标识。在任务边界、呈现选项前、遇到阻塞或需要提问时也会触发。

say.text: 显示当前所有会话的状态。
say.note: Claude 会列出每个会话的项目、分支和状态。

say.text: 这个功能实现完了，报告状态。
我遇到阻塞了，需要数据库迁移审批。

howto.what_en: Claude will display a session identifier (project, branch, task) before every decision, plan, or significant action, and output a status line (COMPLETE, COMPLETE_WITH_NOTES, BLOCKED, NEEDS_INFO) at the end of each major step. When asked for status across sessions, it compiles a sprint view.
howto.when_en: Triggered when multiple Claude Code sessions are detected running in parallel, at task boundaries, before presenting options, when hitting a blocker, or before asking a question.

say_en.text: Show the status of all current sessions.
say_en.note: Claude lists each session's project, branch, and status.

say_en.text: This feature is done, report status.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a COMPLETE status line with changed files and test results.

say_en.text: I'm blocked, need database migration approval.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a BLOCKED status line with the blocker and waiting item.
